title: serapias lingua var. excavata
intro: Serapias lingua var. excavata, commonly known as the tongue orchid, is a rare and unique species of orchid native to the Mediterranean region. It is used in traditional medicine to promote respiratory and cardiovascular health, as well as to treat inflammation and reduce oxidative stress. The plant has been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Serapias lingua var. excavata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
